verdict.rationale: The only webhook evidence is Bridge's documented webhook setup: 'Bridge webhooks allow you to receive real-time notifications when events occur in your Bridge account.' That is a registrable outbound callback, but it covers only the Bridge (issuance/orchestration) part of the crypto offering. Nothing in the pack shows webhook events for Stripe-side stablecoin payments, payouts, onramp, or Treasury balances. Missing for 10: documented webhook event types for Stripe crypto payments/payouts/onramp, details on event catalog, signature verification and retries, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
